content: Ekoro Ɨndɨndu iriika
Hanʉ rwahikirɨ urusikʉ rwa Pɨntɨkʉsitɨ,
abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhiisiriiryɨ Yɨɨsu bhaarɨ bhiibhiringirɨ hamwɨmwɨ.
Kɨtʉkɨrʉ, rɨkahʉrʉka riraka ncha ryʉ ʉmʉkama ʉmʉhaari kurwa mwisaarʉ, rikiizurya inyumba yʉʉsi yɨnʉ bhaarɨmu.
Bhakarora ebhegero bhɨnʉ bhyarɨ ncha zɨndɨmɨ zo omorero, bhɨkanyaragana na kwikara igʉrʉ wa bhʉʉsi.
Abhaatʉ bhayo bhʉʉsi bhakiizuribhwa Ekoro Ɨndɨndu, bhakatanga kʉgamba kʉbhɨgambʉ ɨbhɨndɨ, chɨmbu Ekoro Ɨndɨndu yabhanagiryɨ kʉgamba.
Yɨrusarɨɨmu hayo, bhaareho Abhayaahudi bhanʉ bhaarɨ bharasengera Mungu, kurwa mʉzɨɨsɨ zʉʉsi.
Hanʉ bhiigwirɨ riraka riyo, riribhita ikʉrʉ rya abhaatʉ rikiibhiringa. Bhʉʉsi bhakabha bharuguurirɨ bhʉkʉngʼu, kʉ kʉbha bhakiigwa bharagamba ɨbhɨgambʉ bhyabhʉ.
Hanʉ bhaarɨ bhacharuguurirɨ na kʉtangaara, bhakiibhʉʉrɨra, “Heene, bhanʉ bhʉʉsi bhakʉgamba, bhatarɨ abhiikari bha Gariraaya?
Nangʉ! Ɨbhɨɨrɨbhwɨ itubhʉʉsi turiigwa bharagamba ɨbhɨgambʉ bhyɨtʉ bhya yɨɨka?
Gatɨgatɨ wɨɨtʉ, bhareho abhaatʉ kurwa ɨɨsɨ ya Abhaparisi, Abhamɨɨdi na ya Abhɨɨramu. Bhaareho abhandɨ kurwa ɨɨsɨ ya Mesopotaamiya, Yudeya, Kapadʉʉkiya, Ponto, na Asiya,

Furigiya, Pamufiiriya na Miisiri. Bhaareho abhandɨ kurwa mbaara za mucharʉ cha Riibhiya haguhɨ nʉ ʉrʉbhɨri rwa Kireene na abhagini bhanʉ bhakarwa kʉrʉbhɨri rwa Ruumi, Abhayaahudi na abhandɨ bhanʉ bhiisiriiryɨ ɨnyangi yɨ Ɨkɨyaahudi.
Bhareho abhandɨ bhanʉ nɨ‑Bhakireete na abhandɨ Abhaarabhu. Itubhʉʉsi turiigwa bharakumya Mungu kʉmangʼana gaazɨ amakʉrʉ, kwɨ ɨbhɨgambʉ bhyɨtʉ itubheene!”
Abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhakarʉgʉʉra na bhakiitiimaata, bhakabha bhariibhuurya kʉbha, “Rɨnʉ rɨna nzobhoorokɨ?”
Nawe abhaatʉ abhandɨ bhakabha bharabhakaara, bharabhuga, “Bhagwatirwɨ idivaayi!”
Peetero araragɨrɨra riribhita rya abhaatʉ

Neho Peetero akiimɨɨrɨra hamwɨmwɨ na abhatumwa abhakɨndichazɨ bharya ikumi na wʉmwɨ, akabhabhʉʉrɨra abhaatʉ bhayo kwiraka ikʉrʉ kʉbha, “Imwɨ Abhayaahudi abhakɨndichanɨ na Abhayaahudi bhanʉ mukwikara Yɨrusarɨɨmu hanʉ, munyiitegeerere bhwaheene, nɨbhabhʉʉrɨrɨ amangʼana ganʉ.
Abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhatanywɨrɨ chɨmbu mukwiseega, kʉ kʉbha nangwɨnʉ nɨ‑zɨɨsa isatʉ za ritabhʉʉri.
Nawe ringʼana rɨnʉ nɨ‑rɨnʉ ʉmʉrʉʉtɨrɨri Yʉwɨɨri aagambirɨ,

content.text: Abhaana bhaanyu bhi ikisubhɨ na bhɨ ɨkɨkari bhararootorera,
nʉʉrʉ igʉrʉ wa bhambʉʉsa bhaanɨ abhasubhɨ na abhakari,
nu umwɨri gʉrabha mubhiriiri ncha amasaahɨ,
rʉkɨɨrɨ kuhika urusikʉ rurya ʉrʉkʉrʉ rwu ubhukumya bhwʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ.
Wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akʉsabha kuriina ryʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ,

content: Peetero akangʼeha kʉgamba, “Imwɨ abhaatʉ bha Iziraɨri, mwitegeerere bhwaheene! Mungu umwene akeerecha ʉbhʉkʉrʉ bhwa Yɨɨsu wa Nazarɨɨti kʉbhaniimwɨ, kʉnzɨra yɨ ɨbhɨsɨgʉ, ɨbhɨrʉgʉʉrʉ ni ibhyɨrɨkɨnʼyʉ bhya teemwa nzaru, zɨnʉ Mungu aamʉhɨɨrɨ kokora gatɨ waanyu. Gayo imwʉsi mʉgɨɨzɨ bhwaheene.
Akʉmara Yɨɨsu akatuurwa mʉmabhoko gaanyu, chɨmbu Mungu ɨɨndirɨ kʉrɨngʼaana no okomenya kwazɨ kwɨma ɨkarɨ. Imwɨ mʉkamʉhanikija mʉmabhoko ga abhaatʉ abhabhɨ, bhakamwita igʉrʉ wʉ ʉmʉsarabha.
Nawe Mungu akamuryʉra kurwa mʉbhaku, akamutuurya mʉbhʉrʉrʉ bhwu uruku, kʉ kʉbha ɨtatʉrɨkɨɨnɨ agwatwɨ na zinguru zu uruku.
Ʉmʉtɨmi Daudi akagamba igʉrʉ wa Yɨɨsu,

content.text: Nɨtakusingisa, kʉ kʉbha arɨ ʉrʉbhaara rwo okobhoko kwanɨ ku ubhuryʉ.
kʉ kʉbha ʉrɨ haguhɨ na niinyɨ.’

content: Peetero akangʼeha kʉgamba, “Abhahiiri bhaanɨ mombeerere, nɨgambɨ kwa bhʉkararu mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwanyu kʉbha zaazi Daudi akakwa, akabhiikwa, ni imbihɨra yaazɨ ɨrɨ ɨwɨɨtʉ hanʉ na reero ɨnʉ.
Nawe Daudi aarɨ ʉmʉrʉʉtɨrɨri, akamenya kʉbha, Mungu akaraganʼya kubhwirahiri kʉbha, aratʉʉra ʉmʉʉtʉ wu ubhwibhurwa bhwazɨ kukitumbɨ chazɨ chɨ ɨkɨtɨmi.
Daudi akarora amangʼana ganʉ gakuuza kokorwa, akagamba igʉrʉ wu ukuryʉka kwa Kiriisitʉ,
kʉbha, ataatigirwɨ nyaari nʉ ʉmʉbhɨrɨ gwazɨ gʉtaasarikirɨ.
“Mungu akaryʉra Yɨɨsu kurwa mʉbhaku, na niitwɨ bhʉʉsi nɨ‑bhamɨnyɨɨkɨrɨri bha ringʼana riyo.
Akatiiribhwa igʉrʉ, kuhika ʉrʉbhaara rwu ubhuryʉ rwa Mungu, na kʉsʉngʼaana kwewe ʉbhʉragɨ bhwe Ekoro Ɨndɨndu, wʉʉsi atwitiriirɨ ekegero kɨnʉ mokorora na kwigwa.
Daudi umwene ataatiirirɨ mwisaarʉ, nawe akabhuga,

content.text: kuhika hanʉ nɨkʉtʉʉra abhabhisa bhaazʉ iyaasɨ wa amagʉrʉ gaazʉ.” ’

content: Peetero akamariirya kʉgamba, “Ereenderwa Abhiiziraɨri bhʉʉsi momenye amaheene kʉbha, Yɨɨsu wuyo mwanyaakiryɨ mʉkamwita, newe Mungu akʉrirɨ kʉbha Ʉmʉkʉrʉ na Kiriisitʉ!”
Hanʉ abhaatʉ bhayo bhiigwirɨ amangʼana gayo, gakabhasikɨra mumyʉyʉ jabhʉ. Bhakabhuurya Peetero na abhatumwa abhakɨndichazɨ kʉbha, “Bhahiiri bhɨɨtʉ, nangʉ tokorebhwɨ?”
Peetero akabhagarukirya, “Bhʉʉsibhu mutigɨ ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwanyu na mʉbhatiizwɨ kuriina rya Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ, korereke mobheererwe ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwanyu na niimwɨ mʉrasʉngʼaana ʉmʉbhanʉ gwe Ekoro Ɨndɨndu.
Ʉbhʉragɨ bhʉnʉ ni igʉrʉ waanyu na abhaana bhaanyu, kʉbhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bharɨ mubhyarʉ ɨbhɨndɨ, bhʉʉsi bhayo Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Mungu arabhabhɨrɨkɨra bhabhɨ abhaatʉ bhaazɨ.”
Peetero akangʼeha kʉbhʉʉrɨra abhaatʉ bhayo amangʼana maaru na kʉbhahama, arabhuga, “Mwituuryɨ murwɨ murwibhʉrʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ rʉnʉ!”
Abhaatʉ bhɨkwɨ bhɨtatʉ bhakiisirirya amangʼana ga Peetero, bhakabhatiizwa, bhakagwatana na abhahɨmba abhandɨ bha Yɨɨsu urusikʉ ruyo.
Ubhugwatani bhwa abhahɨmba bha Yɨɨsu
Abhahɨmba bha Yɨɨsu bhakakongʼera kwɨga amiija ga abhatumwa bha Yɨɨsu, bhakagwatana hamwɨmwɨ, kusunyura ʉmʉkaatɨ
na kosengera Mungu.
Abhatumwa bhayo bhaarɨ bharakora amateemo ni ibhyɨrɨkɨnʼyʉ bhyaru, kuhika abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhakasikirwa nʉ ʉrʉhaho nu ubhusuuku bhwa Mungu.
Abhiisirirya bhʉʉsi bhaarɨ nu ubhumwɨmwɨ, bhakasangɨra na kwihaana ebhegero bhyabhʉ kʉbhʉsɨɨgi.
Bhaarɨ bharagurya emenyo ne ebhegero bhyabhʉ, zimpirya zɨnʉ bhaarɨ bhakobhona, bharazesondya kʉrɨngʼaana nu ubhwɨndi bhwʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ.
Zisikʉ zʉʉsi, bhaarɨ bharahunana hamwɨmwɨ mwihekaaru.
Bhaarɨ bhararya ibhyakurya zinyumba zʉʉsi kwa kozomerwa hamwɨmwɨ ne ekoro nzɨrʉ,
ɨnʉ bharakumya Mungu nʉ ʉkʉsɨɨgwa na abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi. Kɨrakabhu Ʉmʉkʉrʉ akangʼeha kutuurya abhandɨ, abhiisirirya bhakoongera kwaruha.

footnotes.text: Pɨntɨkʉsitɨ yaarɨ ni‑sigukuru ya amagesa ga Abhayaahudi. Naatu yaarɨ ni sikʉ 50 kwɨma Ɨpasaka. Rora Abharaawi 23:15‑22.
Kwibhaga riyo Abhayaahudi bhaaru bhaarɨ bhanyaragɨɨnɨ kʉzɨɨsɨ ɨzɨndɨ.
a Kiriisitʉ. Kʉmaragɨrɨra bhʉkʉngʼu, rora Ikiniibhasa.
Kusunyura ʉmʉkaatɨ kwarɨ kʉrakorwa kwa kwiheererya, bhararya hamwɨmwɨ komeeza yʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ igʉrʉ wu ukuhiita Yɨɨsu.
